answer_1.quote: Data-to-Text refers to the process of generating accurate and fluent natural language text from structured data such as tables, lists, graphs etc.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text generated from structured data

answer_2.quote: Following prior work , we use the suite of word-overlap-based automatic metrics from the E2E NLG Challenge , supporting BLEU , , ROUGE-L , METEOR , CIDEr . We also compute a Slot Error Rate (SER) metric...

answer_4.quote: Since automatic metrics have been shown to be inadequate for generation tasks, we also conduct human evaluations on a set of 200 examples randomly sampled from the test set. Concretely, we measure two metrics -accuracy and fluency Accuracy: Human raters are shown the gold text and the predicted text and are instructed to mark the generated text as accurate if it correctly conveys the meaning of the gold text... Fluency: We show the predicted text to raters and ask them how natural and fluent the text sounds on a 1-5 scale...
answer_4.guideline: Raters mark accuracy by comparing generated text to gold text and indicating if meaning is conveyed correctly; they rate fluency on a 1-5 scale for naturalness.
